items.title: Southwest Natural Gas Cash Tops $5 as Record Heat Fuels Lower 48 Price Rally
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices rallied at most hubs Wednesday as 115-degree Southwest heat punctuated a sizzling late-summer pattern, with the next 15 days on track for the highest cooling-demand totals in 50 years.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Climb as Hottest August on Record Refuses to Quit
items.summary: Natural gas futures turned back positive Wednesday as record August heat looked set to bleed into September and LNG feedgas rebounded, giving bulls momentum ahead of Thursday’s government inventory report.

items.title: US Data Center Backlash Adds Risk to Natural Gas Demand Outlooks
items.summary: Political action against data centers in the United States is spreading and has become a bipartisan issue, one that could have potential ramifications for expectations of incremental natural gas demand.

items.title: Hormuz Corridor Talks Ease US LNG Netbacks Off Peak
items.summary: The maximum Gulf Coast LNG netback hit the highest point in more than a year at $22.852/MMBtu Monday before headlines about the Iran war tempered global LNG prices.

items.title: Equinor Boosts Output From One of Europe’s Largest Natural Gas Fields
items.summary: Equinor is flowing more natural gas from Norway to Europe after an expansion of the offshore Troll field came online earlier this week ahead of schedule.

items.title: Hotter Forecasts, Supply Drop Fire Up Natural Gas Futures
items.summary: Natural gas futures climbed sharply at midday Wednesday as warmer weather outlooks, lower production and stronger LNG feedgas demand provided support on the September contract’s penultimate session in the lead.

items.title: Global Natural Gas Shock Has Yet to Hit US Market, but Winter Is Coming
items.summary: The war in Iran upended global energy markets, but the disruption has yet to produce a shock to the US natural gas market. That could change as winter approaches.
